She stands facing forward with hands loosely clasped near the waist, wearing a retro-inspired athletic-chic outfit: a fitted red tank-style crop top with white piping around the neckline and armholes, matching red high-waisted athletic shorts with white piping at the hems, a delicate diamond tennis necklace, silver rings, and small stud earrings. Use professional direct flash with even face and outfit illumination, a slight background shadow, medium framing from mid-thigh up, a 70mm event lens, realistic skin texture, crisp fabric detail, restrained contrast, and subtle event grain. Use an approved generic adult model rather than a public-figure likeness.
